23.DSCR:
Special individuals who possess knowledge of technologies not yet developed within the current body of technical knowledge.
These technologies, which by rights should not exist, are called Black Technology, and depending on how they are used, they can completely overturn the current military balance. For this reason, various organizations have schemed to capture the $$ウィスパード$$, and $$ミスリル$$ acts to protect them.
Black Technology manifests in a $$ウィスパード$$'s mind at some chance trigger, as though someone were whispering to them, but the system and cause behind this phenomenon remain unexplained.
The Lambda Driver is likewise a product of Black Technology brought forth by a $$ウィスパード$$.
At present, $$テレサ・テスタロッサ$$ and $$千鳥かなめ$$ are known to be $$ウィスパード$$, and it is considered all but certain that $$ウィスパード$$ exist within $$アマルガム$$ as well.
23.DSC2:
Special individuals who possess knowledge of technologies not yet developed within the current body of technical knowledge.
These technologies, which by rights should not exist, are called Black Technology, and depending on how they are used, they can completely overturn the current military balance. For this reason, various organizations have schemed to capture the $$ウィスパード$$, and $$ミスリル$$ acts to protect them.
Black Technology manifests in a $$ウィスパード$$'s mind at some chance trigger, as though someone were whispering to them, but the system and cause behind this phenomenon remain unexplained.
The Lambda Driver is likewise a product of Black Technology brought forth by a $$ウィスパード$$.
The $$ウィスパード$$ came into being through the effects of an accident that occurred during the $$オムニ・スフィア$$ experiment being conducted at the Soviet Union's experimental facility $$ヤムスク１１$$. All $$ウィスパード$$ are newborns who were born in the three minutes starting at 11:50 on December 24, the day the accident occurred.

24.DSCR:
A special unit that belonged to $$サイデリアル$$.
Its captain is $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ and its vice-captain is $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.
It uses the $$アンゲロイＧＥＭ$$ and the $$ディオスク$$ as its main force.
It was sent in as a watcher of $$時の牢獄$$, but on $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s own initiative it acted to wipe out Earth's humanity.
When its captain $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was killed in action in the battle over the spacetime restoration, it left the $$地球圏$$.
24.DSC2:
A special unit that belonged to $$サイデリアル$$.
Its captain is $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$ and its vice-captain is $$アンナロッタ・ストールス$$.
It uses the $$アンゲロイＧＥＭ$$ and the $$ディオスク$$ as its main force.
It was originally an elite unit of the military that defended the planet $$ジェミナイ$$, but after being defeated by $$サイデリアル$$ its home planet was devastated, and it was incorporated into $$サイデリアル$$ as it was.
It was secretly sent in as a watcher of $$時の牢獄$$ by $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$, but on $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s own initiative it acted to wipe out Earth's humanity.
When its captain $$ガドライト#pilot$$ was defeated in the battle over the spacetime restoration, it left the $$地球圏$$ and set out on an endless flight from $$サイデリアル$$.
However, with the birth of $$アンナ$$ and $$ロッタ$$, the daughters of $$ガドライト#pilot$$ and $$アンナロッタ$$, hope remains for the survival of the species as well.

25.DSCR:
Those who awakened special abilities and were chosen to pilot $$アクエリオン$$.
The special power they possess is called $$エレメント$$ ability, and without this ability, one cannot even board a $$ベクターマシン$$, let alone combine into $$アクエリオン$$.
Note that the ability differs from one $$エレメント$$ to the next.

26.DSCR:
Commander of the $$アクエリオン$$ operations unit of the special agency 'Earth Regeneration Organization $$ディーバ$$'. He also serves as an instructor at the $$エレメント$$ School. Age unknown.
Because he appears out of nowhere and turns up anywhere, he bears the nickname 'Magician of Divine Speed'. He has mastered a broad and deep range of skills, from conjuring-style tricks, such as producing arrows from nowhere or suddenly enlarging a sheet of paper, to astonishing abilities, such as reading people's minds, calling a wild hawk with a single finger, or reading a person's character and tastes just from their footprints.
Nothing at all is known of his past career apart from his having been a member of the $$アクエリオン$$ excavation expedition. He is a person of many mysteries, whose way of becoming commander is not even known, yet whose words are strangely persuasive. Always giving the $$エレメント$$s hints for getting through difficulties, he leads them to victory.

proofread.reason: pronoun/omitted subject: Gen Fudo is researched male (glossary, pilot 441) and the entry is about him; the old rule made the translator avoid 'he' with 'the commander' and subjectless participles ('Also serves', 'Skills learned', 'Always giving')

27.DSCR:
Its formal name is the Special Agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$, a non-public organization directly under the United Nations.
An extralegal organization whose main purpose is the annihilation of Angels, it has branches in various countries.
Its headquarters are in $$第３新東京市$$ in Japan, with $$碇ゲンドウ$$ as Supreme Commander and $$冬月コウゾウ$$ as Deputy Commander.
Much about its existence is a mystery.

28.DSCR:
The information network system used in $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Short for 'Universal Network' and pronounced 'U-N'.
It was laid down to unify and share information across the multiverse, and anyone with a terminal can read or publish on it.
A valuable source of information for citizens and an entertainment medium at the same time, it became a critically important piece of infrastructure across the multiverse.
It was adopted as the unified standard for information infrastructure in the world after the $$新世時空震動$$ as well.
28.DSC2:
The information network system used in $$ＵＣＷ$$.
Short for 'Universal Network' and pronounced 'U-N'.
It was laid down to unify and share information across the multiverse, and anyone with a terminal can read or publish on it.
A valuable source of information for citizens and an entertainment medium at the same time, it became a critically important piece of infrastructure across the multiverse.
It was adopted as the unified standard for information infrastructure in the world after the $$新世時空震動$$ as well, but some of its communication functions were restricted by $$サイデリアル$$.

29.DSCR:
An incident caused in $$お台場$$ by the terrorist group '$$Ａ２１$$'.
The giant AS '$$ベヘモス$$', equipped with a Lambda Driver, carried out acts of destruction, but the $$ベヘモス$$ was defeated by the $$ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト$$ piloted by $$宗介$$, and $$Ａ２１$$ was suppressed.
During this battle, $$テッサ$$ and $$かなめ$$ shared their feelings, and $$テッサ$$ declared war in the battle of love over $$宗介$$.

30.DSCR:
A mysterious being that artificially causes $$時空震動|lc$$s.
Those who were caught up in that $$時空震動|lc$$ and yet survived develop a phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$', in which both eyes turn red, and fall into a state in which their emotions have died.
Because its figure, smiling amid the light, was even divine, it is called by this name, but its identity and purpose are entirely unknown.
30.DSC2:
A mysterious being that artificially causes $$時空震動|lc$$s.
Those who were caught up in that $$時空震動|lc$$ and yet survived develop a phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$', in which both eyes turn red, and fall into a state in which their emotions have died.
Because its figure, smiling amid the light, was even divine, it is called by this name, but its identity and purpose are entirely unknown.
It was later revealed that its identity was $$アドヴェント#pilot$$, and it became clear that it had been an attempt to find humans possessing the strong power of life that he desired.

32.DSCR:
The independent unit that fought through $$ＡＤＷ$$'s $$破界事変$$ and $$再世戦争$$.
It was organized during the $$破界事変$$ by $$エルガン・ローディック$$, representative of the UN Peacekeeping Council.
Short for 'Z EXtra International Savers', meaning 'special international rescue team'.
After the spacequake '$$カラミティ・バース$$', members of $$ＺＥＵＴＨ$$ displaced from $$ＵＣＷ$$ joined it as well.
It was disbanded once after the $$破界事変$$ ended, then reformed - at which point it was made an independent external unit with the right to act on its own and the authority to inspect and act upon other units within the Earth Federation.
Across both inter-dimensional wars, the $$破界事変$$ and the $$再世戦争$$, it struck down the enemy leadership of many organizations and brought the fighting to an end.

34.DSCR:
The mobile weapon piloted by $$ガドライト#pilot$$, captain of $$ジェミニス$$.
It carried the $$スフィア$$ of the '$$いがみ合う双子$$'.
It was a unit developed for $$ガドライト#pilot$$, the strongest pilot on the planet $$ジェミナイ$$, and the finest technology of $$ジェミナイ$$ was gathered into it. The $$スフィア$$ mounted at that time was initially still under analysis, but when $$ガドライト#pilot$$ awakened as a Reactor, its various functions were elucidated, and $$ジェミニア#robot$$ was completed.
Its basic design follows $$ディオスク$$, and psychokinetic control, armament using light particles, and high close-combat performance are common to both. However, combining these with $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s powerful psychokinesis and outstanding piloting skill, and further with the $$スフィア$$'s $$次元力$$, produces overwhelming combat power. By calculation, that combat power rivaled a battalion made up of $$ディオスク$$.
The $$スフィア$$'s control over phenomena was concentrated on improving this unit's mobility and maneuverability and on landing sure blows against enemies, so it gives a plain impression compared with other units equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but all of it was unified under the concept of delivering a killing blow, and it produced overwhelming offensive power that even surpassed other units equipped with a $$スフィア$$.
To the $$ジェミナイド$$s it was a symbol of their home planet's prosperity, and had become something beyond a mere mobile weapon, so $$ジェミニス$$ loathed $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, which closely resembles it.
Together with $$ジェミニス$$ it was ever victorious and undefeated, but because of its single defeat, the planet $$ジェミナイ$$ met the day of its ruin.
In the decisive battle after the spacetime restoration, it had the $$スフィア$$ of the '$$いがみ合う双子$$' taken from it by $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ and was defeated.

35.DSCR:
A gigantic emigrant ship that serves as the home base of the $$人類銀河同盟$$, searching for a planet suited to human survival.
Military personnel of the $$人類銀河同盟$$ are granted, for 145,000 hours (about 16 years) of military service, the right to apply for limited citizenship and a four-week travel and stay permit at $$アヴァロン$$ (freedom to sleep, freedom to eat and drink, freedom to reproduce).

36.DSCR:
The enormous spacequake that fused $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ and other worlds into one.
Vast in scale, but the physical damage was comparatively light, and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ - culturally similar - grasped the situation quickly and were able to cooperate. As a result, in only three months a huge political body including the space colonies, the Earth Federation, was born, and people's lives returned to calm in a short time.
However, once it became clear that this had completed $$時の牢獄$$, it was suspected that the $$新世時空震動$$ itself had been caused by someone's design, and an explanation is still awaited.
36.DSC2:
The enormous spacequake that fused $$ＵＣＷ$$, $$ＡＤＷ$$ and other worlds into one.
Vast in scale, but the physical damage was comparatively light, and $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ - culturally similar - grasped the situation quickly and were able to cooperate. As a result, in only three months a huge political body including the space colonies, the Earth Federation, was born, and people's lives returned to calm in a short time.
This spacequake was brought about by $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$, one of the $$御使い$$, in order to protect the humans of $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$ who were showing signs of evolution: it first fused the two Earths, then split them in two again, using one of them (the $$翠の地球$$) as camouflage to hide the other (the $$蒼の地球$$) from the eyes of the other $$御使い$$.

37.DSCR:
One of the occupations in the $$ガルガンティア船団$$.
A courier who takes on the delivery of letters, packages and the like and brings them to the person they are addressed to, also using a backpack-type glider to move from ship to ship.

38.DSCR:
Refers to the incident in which he lost his father and older sister to a spacequake.
Having survived that spacequake, he developed '$$血塗られた眼$$' and began to pursue the being '$$テンシ$$' thought to have caused it.

39.DSCR:
A space life form that the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has been at war with for a long time, staking the survival of its species.
There are various variants, such as ammonite-type, ship-type and attack-type, but their ecology and so on are shrouded in mystery.
Through advanced swarm behavior they possess formidable offensive power, but they do not appear to possess anything like a civilization.
39.DSC2:
A space life form that the $$人類銀河同盟$$ has been at war with for a long time, staking the survival of its species.
There are various variants, such as ammonite-type, ship-type and attack-type, but their ecology and so on are shrouded in mystery.
Through advanced swarm behavior they possess formidable offensive power, but they do not appear to possess anything like a civilization.
Their true identity is humanity that evolved, through artificial procedures, to withstand harsh environments.
However, their forms are already far removed from human, and they have become a swarm of bioweapons specialized for survival, having cast aside even ethics, humanitarianism, culture and sensibility.

40.DSCR:
A ride-on robot used on the Earth where the $$ガルガンティア船団$$ exists.
Its formal name is '$$ユンボロイド$$', but the shortened name $$ユンボロ$$ is what is mainly used.
They are basically operated as work machines, for tasks such as hauling supplies and underwater work, but there are also $$ユンボロ$$ specialized for combat, such as those used by pirates.
A legacy of the former civilization called a 'core unit' is used to control the machine.

41.DSCR:
A general term for the mountains where many legacies of the era of the $$黒歴史$$ lie dormant.
They are covered with soil formed by nanomachines, and from them have been excavated various mobile suits and their weapons, beginning with the $$∀ガンダム#robot$$, and even space battleships.
Similar places exist on the Moon as well, and $$ギム・ギンガナム$$ made use of them.
Some $$マウンテンサイクル$$ were dangerous and feared by miners, such as the '$$ロスト・マウンテン$$', said to hold a large number of live nuclear missiles in storage.

42.DSCR:
A holder of a $$スフィア$$.
The term does not simply mean the pilot of a unit equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but refers to a person capable of drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.
42.DSC2:
A holder of a $$スフィア$$.
The term does not simply mean the pilot of a unit equipped with a $$スフィア$$, but refers to a person capable of drawing out a $$スフィア$$'s power.
Specifically, a person who has awakened a $$スフィア$$ to the Second Stage or higher is a Reactor, and Reactors themselves are also ranked by Stage according to the state of their $$スフィア$$'s awakening.
Furthermore, at the Third Stage or higher, a person can draw out a $$スフィア$$'s power even when not aboard a unit, and manifest various effects called $$スフィア・アクト$$.

43.DSCR:
The Alps-class land battleship with $$ジャミル$$ serving as captain.
Although formally a 'land battleship', it can also travel over water by hovering, so its range of action is wide.
It can carry up to six mobile suits, and its main complement was the $$ガンダムＸ$$, the $$ガンダムエアマスター$$ and the $$ガンダムレオパルド$$.
It was also the living space of pilots such as $$ガロード$$ and the others, and when $$ロアビィ$$ came to be exclusively employed by $$フリーデン$$, he had set up a relaxation room at his own expense to make the journey comfortable.
Although it was heavily damaged in the battle when $$ガロード$$ was sent off into space, the space battleship that $$ジャミル$$ and the others later obtained was given the name '$$フリーデン$$' once again.

proofread.reason: omitted subject / pronoun: the Japanese says Roybea (male) set up the room himself at his own expense (自腹で設けていた); the passive dropped the agent and the name was repeated instead of 'he' (the second ロアビィ token is therefore replaced by 'he'/'his')

44.DSCR:
A general term for the creatures and objects said to be the natural enemies of intelligent life.
It is said that battles against $$バアル$$ have been waged across the entire galaxy since the distant past, and that they appear in great numbers in response to the rebirth of the universe, which occurs on a cycle of 12,000 years. Some also say that it was beings called 'gods' who fought against $$バアル$$, and that humanity was powerless.
None of this information has been substantiated, either, and the truth of the matter and their total numbers remain shrouded in mystery to this day.
44.DSC2:
A general term for the creatures and objects said to be the natural enemies of intelligent life.
It is said that battles against $$バアル$$ have been waged across the entire galaxy since the distant past, and that they appear in great numbers in response to the rebirth of the universe, which occurs on a cycle of 12,000 years. Some also say that it was beings called 'gods' who fought against $$バアル$$, and that humanity was powerless.

During the fighting, it was learned that they are generated from the 'force that tries to vanish', one of the two great forces that make up the universe, but it is unclear whether that force itself gives rise to $$バアル$$, or whether creatures absorbed by it are $$バアル$$.

uncertain: kw 23 DSC2: the sentence about the accident at Yamsk 11 has no subject; I took it to be the Whispered (the following sentence says all of them were born in those three minutes), not the Lambda Driver, and wrote 'The Whispered came into being through the effects of an accident'. 11:50 is left without AM/PM as in the source; 'the three minutes starting at 11:50' is my reading of 11:50 plus 3 minutes.

kw 23: Jigoku's 'within Amalgam' became the token for Amalgam; 'a Whispered's mind' (kept from Jigoku) reads oddly with the glossary English 'Whispered' - the glossary English may need a decision (e.g. 'Whispered one').

kw 24: the source is present tense for the captain and equipment and past for the rest, and I followed that. 戦死 (DSCR) = 'killed in action' but DSC2 says 敗れた (defeated); both kept as the source has them.
kw 24 DSC2: 種の存続 = 'survival of the species', taken as the Geminis' own species. Anna and Lotta are new pilot tokens; the source only says they are the daughters (娘) of Gadlight and Annalotta.

kw 25/26: エレメント is the token for the pilots' category name (Element); 'Element ability' is written as the token plus ability. ベクターマシン is left as plain 'Vector Machine' as in other Tengoku briefs' Jigoku English (not in the glossary).

kw 26: Gen Fudou is a known character, but the Japanese has no pronoun, so I used 'the commander' / 'they-free' constructions instead of he. 地球再生機構ディーバ = 'Earth Regeneration Organization DEAVA'; kw_090 gives the spelled-out Latin name (Division of EArth Vitalization Advancement), so the English of the organization may need to be settled once. 神速の魔術師 = 'Magician of Divine Speed' is my rendering; アクエリオン発掘調査団 = 'excavation expedition'.

kw 27/32: 国際連合 and 国連 are written as plain 'United Nations' and 'UN'. Jigoku used the token for UN (the Universal Network entry, kw 28) for 国連 in kw 32, but that token is a different Japanese word, so I did not reuse it.

kw 28: Jigoku's 'post-Neo-Spacequake world' (a tokenized hack) was replaced by 'the world after the $$新世時空震動$$', because a token for 新世時空震動 exists. Jigoku's 'organised' fixed to 'organized' (kw 32) for American spelling.

kw 29: 心を交わし is 'shared their feelings' (Tessa and Kaname); the declaration of war is given to Tessa only (subject of 宣戦布告をした). Arbalest uses the glossary token for ＡＲＸ－７　アーバレスト; the source only says アーバレスト.

kw 30/38: テンシ = Tenshi kept as in kw_000. 'He' in kw 38 comes from the Japanese 彼 in the second sentence; the first sentence (a father and an older sister were lost) is passive, as the source names no owner. In kw 30 DSC2 'he desired' is the Japanese 彼 referring to Advent; 'it' for それ (the artificial spacequakes or the being's acts) is kept ambiguous.

kw 32: Jigoku 'audit and act upon' (監査権) - the Tengoku source now says 監察権 (oversight/inspection), so I changed it to 'inspect and act upon'. Everything else is the Jigoku English with names turned into tokens.
